ruleCards.content:
The Adventure deck consists of 5 cards, ordered from 1 to 5. Adventures must be completed in this order.

At the start of the game, place the Adventure cards in order (1 to 5), adventure side face up.

When you complete an Adventure, flip it and gain its reward for the rest of the game (unless stated otherwise).
ruleCards.title: Caine's Adventures

name: POMNI
note: Rules-enforced Pro deck (server hero pomni), mirrored from unmatched.cards deck 1y_5 "POMNI" by Calton_White (Discord .andregea), version NVDqtJ4W- "final balance patch" — the SAME source the engine converted from (data/heroes/pomni.rules.ts, engine JollyGrin/unbrewed-engine#1056 on the feature/pomni train, DSL 0.94.0 / PROTOCOL 40), so every rules-relevant field is engine-exact. A LAB deck; 18 author rulings are still open engine-side. Titles are verbatim, including the author's lowercase (ricochet super move, harmless "prank", the funny one!, Relative chaos, reward 2), the U+00AE in Stupid Burger, the embedded newline in the Adventure 4 and 5 titles, the U+2019 in Adventure 4 and the U+00A0 in Adventure 5 — art matches on the lowercased verbatim title, so never retype them (this file is written with \u escapes for that reason). THE ADVENTURE SIDE DECK: the five double-sided Adventure cards are ten faces (Adventure n / Reward n). The engine seeds them into public piles and never shuffles or draws them, so they live in `extraCards`, not `cards`: the 30-card deck stays 30 for the sandbox pool, the stats and the rules lock, and the faces still resolve art and show as linked cards in the preview. 1y_5 itself lists them as ten 0-boost schemes with no image. ART is all the AUTHOR'S own work ("all art was created by me") and comes from his other publication of this deck, the-unmatched.club 8881 (https://www.the-unmatched.club/c/heroes/pomni.8881), where every card carries a finished full-card render as `replacementImage`: the ten faces are the club entries "ADV n front" / "ADV n back" (mapped by card number, not by title — the club gives them no titles), and the 12 main-deck faces are the club renders too, because they carry the current card text where the images 1y_5 hotlinks still print older wording. All are mirrored into public/evergreen-decks/art/1y_5 (i.imgur.com / i.ibb.co hotlinks upstream; #446 standard, q80 webp, at most 1600 px) and drawn full-bleed via cardImage — never through the generated template and never through the art-generation pipeline. The Adventure faces are LANDSCAPE cards stored the way the author uploaded them (rotated a quarter turn in a portrait frame); each carries `cardImage.turn: "ccw"` and the card renderer turns it upright in every slot. reward-4 is a 458x640 upload, shipped as-is. cardback.webp is his `cardsBack`, token-pomni.webp / token-jax.webp his two character avatars. His two character cards (melee, and the ranged flip side Reward 1 turns to) are NOT mirrored: Pro draws no character card, and a hero-card.webp in this folder would also list the deck on /table. Hand-edits against the API payload: the faces moved to `extraCards`; three of the four rule cards dropped (two are blank, one is a braille drawing that reads as noise in a tooltip); art URLs. Where the two publications disagree on text (harmless "prank" DURING vs IMMEDIATELY, Relative chaos' retrieve) the snapshot keeps 1y_5, which is what the engine encodes. Engine serves the hero at tier `lab`.
